strings.lobby.description:
Chat under unusual rules!

I'm waiting for 3 players to start. Once play begins, rules apply to everyone posting in this exact channel. Start a message with `-# ` to whisper: the whole message is exempt.

The invitation lasts three minutes. Use /rules for current rules. A manager can end the game with /end-game.

Rules evolve as the conversation continues. Keep chatting for a chance to choose the next one.

Breaking Moments pause all other rules for 2 minutes.

strings.recovery.title: New Rules — recovery status
strings.recovery.description:
Recovery {generation} · {stage}
This is a private view of saved facts. Enforcement stays paused. A manager can close the game with /end-game.
strings.recovery.manager_required: A server manager must view recovery status in the game’s channel.
strings.recovery.unavailable: That recovery view is no longer available. Use /rules in the game’s channel for the current view.
strings.recovery.no_unknown: No unknown delivery found in the saved records. This does not confirm channel access or authorize resume.
strings.recovery.output_scope: Current recovery work and outstanding output, plus the latest complete receipt for this family where retained. Families can refer to the same send; proof in one does not clear another. No Discord history has been checked.
strings.recovery.empty: No retained output on this page. An empty page is not proof that a message was never sent.
strings.recovery.evidence.unsent: Conclusive never-sent evidence is saved for this engine output.
strings.recovery.evidence.acknowledged: A successful acknowledgement is saved. Missing publication time remains unknown.
strings.recovery.evidence.prepared: Prepared with no recorded send attempt. This does not clear other delivery claims.
strings.recovery.blocker.resume_unavailable: • Live resume is not wired yet; manager ending remains available.
strings.recovery.blocker.capabilities_unknown: • Fresh essential channel and marker access has not been verified by this view.
strings.recovery.blocker.version: • A saved version or choice cannot be read safely by this build.
strings.recovery.blocker.legacy: • This legacy admission needs explicit operator review.
strings.recovery.blocker.existing_pause: • An earlier capability, dependency, or recovery pause still needs resolution.
strings.recovery.blocker.missing_state: • Expected saved game or clock state is missing.
strings.recovery.blocker.owner_changed: • The current game position differs from its recovery barrier.
strings.recovery.blocker.mode: • The saved mode cannot be resumed by this build.
strings.recovery.blocker.clock_unknown: • A required publication-owned clock is not established.
strings.recovery.blocker.legacy_revival: • The saved revival has no supported original publication clock.
strings.recovery.blocker.unknown_delivery: • Some output still has unknown delivery; inspect the families below.
strings.reboot.notice_title: New Rules — picking up where we left off!

strings.reboot.blocked_description: The game is paused because I couldn’t finish recovery safely. Scores are saved. Please contact the bot host; a server manager can still use /end-game.
strings.reboot.retired_status: That diagnostic view has been retired. Use /rules to see the game’s current status.
